targeted_issue_reports.report_body:
Recovery reference-data follow-up for #3 (2026-11-02 UTC; bounded public GETs, no production changes).

**AAPL pilot: index reference feeds are not the underlying primary-listing exchange.** Official [index-component specification](https://www.bitget.com/legacy-docs/uta/public/Get-Index-Components) defines `componentList.exchange`, `spotPair`, `equivalentPrice`, `weight`. A successful [current AAPL request](https://api.bitget.com/api/v3/market/index-components?symbol=AAPLUSDT) returned REUTERS, TIGER, PYTH, DXFEED, BINANCE_INDEX, HYPERLIQUID. These are returned pricing-source labels, NOT primary-listing MICs. No request to Binance was made.

The official [stock-perpetual guide](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603835927), linked from a stock listing notice, says prices derive from traditional-market data providers; index sources may change; stock indices use provider feeds under the regular-futures methodology. Its four-provider list differs from this current six-component AAPL snapshot: retain both, do not manufacture a historical basket. No authoritative historical primary-listing mapping or session ledger was obtained.

Successful recent listing/delisting queries for [2026-10-25, 2026-11-01) recovered 8/2 notices (details in #10), not historical membership. [Stock listing 12560603899143](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899143) states only 29 October 2026 (UTC+8), with no precise first executable timestamp. Its index `cTime`, interpreted as Unix milliseconds, is 2026-10-29T14:26:20Z, while article `datePublished` explicitly says 2026-10-29T14:26:20+08:00 (=06:26:20Z): unresolved eight-hour publication discrepancy, never an effective-time substitute. Announcement ID is not a stable derivative-contract ID.

Persisted uncommitted evidence: `research/data/recovery-reference-data-2026-11-02.json` (exact URLs, UTC, status, raw bytes/base64 and SHA-256). Shared budget: 9 first-party GET transactions including 2 redirects, 487,004 body bytes (500,598 including saved headers), 10-second limit/request, no retries/accounts/orders.

Fail-closed `research/reference_coverage_gate.py`: 5 passing tests; current feeds/notices cannot imply history. Still blocked: verified 2026-09-17 opening inventory; historical derivative/underlying identity and separate primary-listing/reference-source interval mappings; historical timezone/DST/session/halt/exception ledger. No session-performance or survivorship-corrected comparison authorized. No issue closure/labels/commits/branches.

Recovery reference-data follow-up for #3 (2026-11-02 UTC): **the documented announcement request works for a valid recent interval**, unlike the prior rejected 45-day requests.

Reused saved official `/legacy-docs/uta/public/Get-Announcements` raw documentation (no refetch). Correct route retains its documented spelling `/api/v3/public/annoucements`; required `language=en_US`; documented listing/delisting `annType`; `limit=10`; cursor is the preceding page's last `annId`. Exact successful requests, both HTTP 200 / code `00000`:

- `https://api.bitget.com/api/v3/public/annoucements?language=en_US&annType=coin_listings&startTime=1792886400000&endTime=1793491199999&limit=10` → 8 notices.
- `https://api.bitget.com/api/v3/public/annoucements?language=en_US&annType=symbol_delisting&startTime=1792886400000&endTime=1793491199999&limit=10` → 2 notices.

That is [2026-10-25T00:00Z, 2026-11-01T00:00Z), safely within 30 days. All returned timestamps fall within the request interval. No pagination/completeness guarantee is claimed; spot/copy-trading/margin results are not futures lifecycle inventory.
